title: Isolated staging environment
summary: A local staging runtime and full sanitized corpus copy were built without production or remote access.
evidence: The full local suite passed 10 of 10 tests.
Staging binds only to loopback and strips external provider credentials.
The sanitized copy passed database integrity validation and retained the complete knowledge-chunk count.
Operational records and referral contact details are absent.
limitations: The local runtime validates isolation and corpus availability. Builder delivery waits on host availability, and answer quality remains governed by the baseline review.
